description: Source code for a Linux kernel module implementing a trivial Ethernet relay, including functions for handling network frames, managing relay instances, and integrating with debugfs and netdevice notifier.

methods.name: trelay_handle_frame
methods.description: Handles incoming Ethernet frames, forwarding them if appropriate.

methods.name: trelay_open
methods.description: Opens the relay device file, setting private data.

methods.name: trelay_do_remove
methods.description: Removes a relay instance, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: trelay_find
methods.description: Finds a relay instance associated with a given network device.

methods.name: tr_device_event
methods.description: Handles network device events, such as unregistering devices.

methods.name: trelay_remove_write
methods.description: Handles write operations to trigger removal of relay instances.

methods.name: trelay_remove_release
methods.description: Releases resources when the relay device file is closed.

methods.name: trelay_do_add
methods.description: Creates and registers a new relay between two network devices.

methods.name: trelay_add_write
methods.description: Handles write operations to add new relay instances.

methods.name: trelay_init
methods.description: Initializes the Ethernet relay module, setting up debugfs and notifier.

methods.name: trelay_exit
methods.description: Cleans up the Ethernet relay module, unregistering notifier and removing relays.
